# Hi, I'm Casey

[![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/kckhchen.com-222?style=flat&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://kckhchen.com)
[![Blog](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blog-CC0000?style=flat&logo=jekyll&logoColor=white)](https://kckhchen.com/blog/)
[![Sootow][sootow-badge]](https://sootow.com)

Data scientist, developer, and translator based in Taipei and Taichung, Taiwan.
MSc in Statistics from the University of Warwick. Economics + English Literature BA from National Taiwan University.

Currently working on [Intaglio](https://github.com/kckhchen/intaglio), a tool that turns an Obsidian vault into a Jekyll blog.
NLP projects include [zh-TW NLP product categorizer](https://github.com/kckhchen/zh-tw-nlp-product-categorizer) and [pollparse](https://github.com/kckhchen/pollparse).
The latter powers the poll web service [Sootow](https://sootow.com).
